## How I tested it

- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format --check .` are clean
- [ ] A behavior change has a test and a line in the README
- [ ] A new VERIFIED entry links its monitor report and `journalctl -t osdless` lines
- [ ] No real serial numbers, host names or paths from my machine in fixtures or docs
